Iron ore is collected either from the bog ore outcroppings, from iron deposits or via a [[zombie ore mine]]. Bog ore outcroppings can be found in the [[swamp]] and in the area directly north of the [[workyard]]. The only iron deposit at the moment can be found along the northern most cliff face, north of the [[cabin in the woods]]. The [[zombie ore mine]] is also located there. Iron ore can be smelted into [[iron ingot]]s or sold to the [[blacksmith]]. More on the locations of iron ore and how to get it can be found [[Mining#Iron_Ore|here]].
